name: Arctic White
psychology: White reflects clarity, purity, and spaciousness. In modern Indian home design, white kitchen and wardrobe shutters are highly favored to maximize daylight and create a bright, spacious feel.
highlights: German PUR hotmelt zero edge swell protection

name: Piano Black & Onyx
psychology: Black represents power, mystery, and formal elegance. Combined with brushed gold profiles, our deep black acrylic finishes deliver a luxurious boutique feel.

name: Graphite Grey & Charcoal
psychology: Grey offers a neutral, sophisticated balance. It is the leading specification for contemporary modular kitchens, acting as the perfect anchor for warm wood textures.

name: Sand Dune & Beige
psychology: Beige is comforting, warm, and natural. Pair with deep matte forest greens or navy blues to create a beautiful, organic two-tone kitchen.

name: Midnight Navy
psychology: Navy Blue brings depth, serenity, and palatial elegance. Midnight Navy in high-gloss ACRYGLASS creates a stunning, jewel-like under-counter focal point.

name: Sage Green
psychology: Green connects interiors directly with nature, inspiring calmness. Sage Green in a nano-matte ACRYMATTE finish is the ultimate Japandi surface.

name: Burgundy Wine
psychology: Burgundy is soulful, energetic, and luxurious. Perfect for creating a dramatic statement in dining areas or hospitality showrooms.

name: Champagne Beige
psychology: Champagne offers a soft, metallic-adjacent elegance. It is highly specified for high-end walk-in wardrobes and master bedroom dresser panels.

name: Walnut Wood
psychology: Walnut represents classic heritage and warm organic luxury. Our wood-look acrylic panels replicate actual wood grains with zero maintenance.

name: Natural Oak
psychology: Oak represents strength, lightness, and clean Scandinavian lines. Highly popular for open kitchen island drawers and floating vanity units.

name: Teak Heritage
psychology: Teak is deeply embedded in Indian furniture traditions. Our teak-patterned acrylic offers that rich golden teak color with absolute scratch resistance.

name: Rose Gold
psychology: Rose Gold is highly trendy, adding a soft metallic glamour. It is specified for jewelry boutique backdrops and feature panels in formal lounges.

name: Copper Silk
psychology: Copper adds instant solar warmth. SurajWood Brushed Copper Silk satin panels reflect golden night lighting with unmatched hospitality luxury.

name: Emerald Green
psychology: Emerald is the color of precious gems, denoting high wealth. When used as custom showcase backing panels, it highlights crystal dinnerware.
highlights: Class B1 fire code certified safe

name: Ivory Cream
psychology: Ivory represents comfort and classic traditionalism. It is a softer, warmer alternative to stark white, creating a cozy and luxurious modular kitchen.
highlights: Turmeric and heavy curry stain proof
